storyCards.headline: You Don't Mess Around With Jim: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Jim Croce's "You Don't Mess Around With Jim" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. You Don't Mess Around with Jim is the third studio album and major-label debut by American singer-songwriter Jim Croce; it released in April 1972 by ABC Records.

History and release
The album was recorded over a three- to four-week period for about $18,000, with most funding coming from the PolyGram Group in Baarn, the Netherlands, on the basis of hearing an eight-song demonstration tape assembled by production team Cashman & West.

The deal with PolyGram was made after team attorney Phil Kurnit approached a contact within the record company, who then had PolyGram executives listen to the demo tape.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #8 on the Hot 100.
